tasks.label: php: check syntax
args: $files = Get-ChildItem -Path 'src','public' -Recurse -Filter '*.php'; foreach ($file in $files) { php -l $file.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; Write-Host 'Syntax check passed.'
